name: @epoch/experience-runtime
description: Epoch Experience Runtime host model (W013): tenant-scoped device sessions over the W011 device-descriptor vocabulary, a deterministic virtual-time frame/tick scheduling model (testable without real clocks), typed runtime events (frame, state, lifecycle), session lifecycle transitions, and a typed session-error taxonomy — pure typed data with zero concrete renderers, zero engine vocabulary, and zero wall-clock dependence.
